note: 半徑 1.25 m；接口與 B03 相同。
up: +Z (Blender); FBX exported Y-up, -Z forward, transforms baked
lod_rule: LOD1 about 50%, LOD2 about 15% of LOD0 (small parts dropped first, then collapse decimate)

unity.axes: imported with bakeAxisConversion: Unity local = (Blender x, z, y); the model front faces Unity -Z (seen in the captures)
unity.lod_group: objects end in _LOD0/_LOD1/_LOD2 under one root, so Unity builds a LODGroup on import
unity.collision: CR08_Bend_Collision: add a MeshCollider (convex off); hide its renderer

states: 水面是獨立模型 <ID>_water_v001.fbx，不在渠身 FBX 裡：原點與渠身相同，放同一位置；UV u 0–1 橫跨、v 沿水流每公尺 +1，材質用流動 shader，沒有烘貼圖
modeling_method: procedural mesh construction (art/source/creek-repair-b/); procedural shaders (cr_mats.py) baked to a UV atlas
reference: art/references/CR08/selected.png (AI three-view; proportions taken from the work pack's written sizes, not measured from the image)
unity_import_verified: imported by Editor/CreekRepairModelCheck under Unity 6000.0.85f1 (the project pins 82f1); results in artifacts/creek-repair-unity/unity-verify-report.txt, not in this file

water.uv: u 0..1 across the channel, v in metres downstream, whole metres per piece
